CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Christ.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation.

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)

   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

5. Which response best shows understanding of Wedding? (1 mark)

   B. Use The Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Creation of Plants and Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Use Creation of Plants and Animals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Creation of Plants and Animals.
   C. Apply the teaching of Creation of Plants and Animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Creation of Plants and Animals has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Sharing values? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sharing values.
   B. Say Sharing values has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Sharing values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Sharing values to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story: Holy Bible? (1 mark)

   B. Say Bible Story: Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Bible Story: Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of My 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)

   B. Apply the teaching of My 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)

   C. Say Healing of of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Healing of of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

14. Which response best shows understanding of Physical? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Physical.
   B. Say Physical has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Physical to insult classmates of other faiths.

15. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible Story;? (1 mark)

   B. Say The Bible Story; has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible Story;.
   D. Use The Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.
